cases.requirement: Every observer must see matching primary and index generations, including at a checkpoint that may throw.
Every observer must see matching primary and index generations. Reference replacement is atomic in this model; a checkpoint may throw.
Two separately prepared, accepted increments must increase the counter by two, even when both prepare before either executes.

Two accepted increments must increase the counter by two. A false return rejects that attempt; the caller explicitly retries once from a fresh preparation after a conflict. Each returned function executes atomically in this model.
Hints are independent booleans. Partial completion is permitted and the caller retries after an interrupted checkpoint before declaring both complete.
Redelivery of the same visit identifier must leave the total number of visits unchanged.
